findings.question: Breeder document scans (Birth certificates, naturalisation decrees and other documents that establish identity): the name of the register or system

findings.title: 1 an de la operaționalizarea SIIEASC la nivel național
findings.note: DGEP's new site (dgep.mai.gov.ro, the old depabd.mai.gov.ro now redirects here) announces SIIEASC, which holds the electronic archive of civil status acts; a different URL from the unfetchable depabd one.

review.established: Sistemul Informatic Integrat pentru Emiterea Actelor de Stare Civilă (SIIEASC)
review.reason: The page text matches the quote apart from whitespace inside the parenthesis ('(SIIEASC)'). It names SIIEASC as the national system for issuing civil status documents, but it does not mention scans of breeder documents.

findings.question: Breeder document scans (Birth certificates, naturalisation decrees and other documents that establish identity): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: În ceea ce privește actele de stare civilă stocate în arhiva electronică, precizăm că au fost validate 2.926.784 acte de stare civilă dintre care 2.083.926 acte de naștere
findings.quote_english: As regards the civil status records stored in the electronic archive, 2,926,784 civil status records have been validated, of which 2,083,926 birth records
findings.value: 2.926.784 acte de stare civilă (civil status records) validated in the SIIEASC electronic archive
findings.title: 1 an de la operationalizarea SIIEASC la nivel național
findings.note: Count of digitised civil status records validated in the electronic archive as of the one-year mark (31 March 2026); not the total historical stock.

review.reason: The quote appears verbatim, but it only gives counts of validated records in an unnamed 'arhiva electronică', so it does not name the register or system.

findings.question: Civil registry core (Births, deaths, marriages, residence and the national person identifier): the name of the register or system

findings.quote_english: the establishment of the National Register of Persons Records as the main component of the National IT System for Population Records.

review.reason: The quote appears verbatim on the DGEP history page and names the national population register and the system it belongs to.

findings.question: Document issuance history (Which passports and ID cards were issued to whom, and their revocation state): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: d) constituie, administrează, valorifică şi actualizează Registrul naţional de evidenţă a paşapoartelor simple, denumit în continuare RNEPS, şi furnizează, la cerere, date din cuprinsul acestuia, în condiţiile legii;
findings.quote_english: d) establishes, administers, uses and updates the National Register of Simple Passports, hereinafter RNEPS, and supplies data from it on request, under the law;
findings.value: Registrul naţional de evidenţă a paşapoartelor simple – RNEPS (National Register of Simple Passports)

review.established: Registrul naţional de evidenţă a paşapoartelor simple (RNEPS)
review.reason: The quote appears verbatim in Article 11(d) of the extracted text of the order, among the duties of the Direcţia generală de paşapoarte. It names the passport register (covering ordinary passports only).

findings.question: Firearms register (Licensed firearms and their holders): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: (1) În cadrul Inspectoratului General al Poliţiei Române funcţionează Registrul Naţional al Armelor, ca sistem complex de prelucrare a datelor cu privire la evidenţa armelor şi a componentelor esenţiale, a deţinătorilor de arme
findings.quote_english: (1) The National Firearms Register operates within the General Inspectorate of the Romanian Police, as a complex data-processing system for records of firearms and essential components, of firearm holders
findings.value: Registrul Naţional al Armelor (National Firearms Register)
findings.title: Legea nr. 295/2004 privind regimul armelor, componentelor esențiale şi al muniţiilor (republicată, consolidated)
findings.note: Art. 97 of Law 295/2004 as consolidated to 19-03-2026, hosted by the Romanian Police; the same article also establishes the eARM online platform.

review.reason: The quote appears verbatim in the text extracted from the Law 295/2004 PDF. It names the national firearms register, which records firearms and their holders and runs within the IGPR.

findings.question: Firearms register (Licensed firearms and their holders): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: (1) În cadrul Inspectoratului General al Poliţiei Române funcţionează Registrul Naţional al Armelor, ca sistem complex de prelucrare a datelor cu privire la evidenţa armelor şi a componentelor esenţiale, a deţinătorilor de arme
findings.quote_english: (1) The National Firearms Register operates within the General Inspectorate of the Romanian Police, as a complex data-processing system for records of firearms and essential components, of firearm holders

findings.title: Legea nr. 295/2004 privind regimul armelor, componentelor esențiale şi al muniţiilor (republicată, consolidated)

findings.question: Judicial & criminal justice (Criminal records, court case files and judgments): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Principalele atribuţii ale Direcţiei Cazier Judiciar, Statistică şi Evidenţe Operative: Organizează, în condiţiile legii, cazierul judiciar pentru ţinerea evidenţei persoanelor fizice şi juridice condamnate
findings.quote_english: Main attributions of the Directorate for Criminal Records, Statistics and Operative Records: organises, under the law, the criminal record for keeping records of natural and legal persons convicted
findings.value: cazierul judiciar (criminal record), organised by the Direcţia Cazier Judiciar, Statistică şi Evidenţe Operative (Directorate for Criminal Records, Statistics and Operative Records)
findings.title: Direcţia Cazier Judiciar, Statistică şi Evidenţe Operative
findings.note: Covers criminal records only, not court case files or judgments; also establishes the operator.

review.reason: The quote appears verbatim on the police directorate page and names the criminal record register (cazierul judiciar). It covers criminal records only, not court case files.

findings.question: Official gazette and legislation (Authentic text of laws and regulations): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Art. 1. — Monitorul Oficial al României este publicația oficială a statului român, în care se publică actele prevăzute de Constituție, de prezenta lege și de alte acte normative.
findings.quote_english: Art. 1. — The Official Gazette of Romania is the official publication of the Romanian state, in which the acts provided for by the Constitution, this law and other normative acts are published.
findings.value: Monitorul Oficial al României (Official Gazette of Romania)
findings.title: Legea nr. 202/1998 privind organizarea Monitorului Oficial al României (republicată, M. Of. Partea I nr. 511/2017)
findings.note: Republished law text as it appeared in the Official Gazette, hosted by the gazette's publisher.

review.reason: Art. 1 appears verbatim in the extracted text of Law 202/1998, apart from line breaks. It names the official gazette where legal acts are published.

findings.question: Official gazette and legislation (Authentic text of laws and regulations): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Art. 18. — Regia Autonomă „Monitorul Oficial” editează Monitorul Oficial al României atât în format tipărit, cât și în format electronic.
findings.quote_english: Art. 18. — The Autonomous Company 'Monitorul Oficial' publishes the Official Gazette of Romania in both printed and electronic format.
findings.title: Legea nr. 202/1998 privind organizarea Monitorului Oficial al României (republicată, M. Of. Partea I nr. 511/2017)
findings.note: Operator that produces the gazette in print and electronic form; it works under the Government through the General Secretariat of the Government per Art. 3.

review.reason: Art. 18 appears verbatim in the extracted text, apart from line breaks. It names the gazette, which the Regia Autonomă 'Monitorul Oficial' publishes in print and electronic form.

findings.question: Treasury and state accounts (Budget execution, treasury payments and government accounting): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Ați accesat Portalul FOREXEBUG al Ministerului Finanțelor! Bun venit! Pentru accesarea funcționalităților Punctului Unic de Acces, este necesară autentificarea.
findings.quote_english: You have accessed the FOREXEBUG Portal of the Ministry of Finance! Welcome! Authentication is required to access the functions of the Single Point of Access.
findings.value: Portalul FOREXEBUG (FOREXEBUG portal) of the Ministerul Finanțelor
findings.title: Punct unic de acces - ForexePublic
findings.note: The same page states that budget commitment execution reports (Execuție Angajamente Bugetare) are sent to public institutions through it; it is a reporting portal rather than the treasury ledger itself. This subpage URL differs from the earlier cited root.

review.reason: The page could not be fetched: WebFetch and curl both failed with ECONNRESET or a connection error several times, so the quote could not be verified. A FOREXEBUG portal login page would not by itself establish the treasury system in any case.

findings.question: Benefits & pensions (Entitlements, contributions and payment history for social security and state pensions): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Casa Națională de Pensii Publice începe modernizarea sistemului informatic integrat
findings.quote_english: The National Public Pension House begins modernising the integrated IT system
findings.value: sistemul informatic integrat (integrated IT system) of Casa Națională de Pensii Publice
findings.title: Comunicat noul sistem informatic integrat al Casei Naționale de Pensii Publice
findings.note: A generic system name, not a formally named register; an earlier attempt with the same value failed blind review, so this may again be judged too generic. The release also says HG 496/2024 funds a new integrated system.

review.reason: The quote appears verbatim in the CNPP press release of 17.05.2024. It refers only generically to modernising CNPP's 'sistemul informatic integrat', with no proper name for the pensions register or system.
